definition_en: final in order, the most recent, or to continue for a time
core_image: 跑道终点线旁，最后一名选手仍在向前跑

senses.title: Final in order
senses.definition: Final in order
senses.example: She was the last to finish the race.
senses.exampleCN: 她是最后一个跑完比赛的。

senses.whyCN: last 是古英语 latost 的缩约形式，即 late 的最高级；最初指落在最后的。

senses.title: The most recent

senses.whyCN: 因为最近发生的事也就是此刻之前的那一件，last 就表示上一个的。

senses.definition: To continue for a time
senses.example: The film lasts two hours.
senses.why: The verb last is a separate Old English word, læstan, meaning to continue or endure.
senses.whyCN: 动词 last 是另一个古英语词 læstan，意为持续、忍受。

definition_en: the season after winter, a water source, a coiled metal, or to jump upward
core_image: 三月里河边的柳枝冒出嫩芽，风吹过水面
scene: 三月里河边的柳枝冒出嫩芽，风吹过水面 In March the willows by the river push out new shoots, and spring arrives with the wind.
sceneCN: 这里 spring 是「春天」（第 01 个义项）；句意是花儿在春天开放。

senses.title: The season after winter
senses.definition: The season after winter

senses.why: This is the oldest sense: a sudden leap, which also shaped all the others.
senses.whyCN: 这是最古老的含义：突然一跃，其余义项都由它生发。

senses.title: To get something by paying money
senses.definition: to obtain something by paying money for it
senses.example: She bought a new coat yesterday.
senses.exampleCN: 她昨天买了一件新大衣。
senses.why: Buy goes back to Old English bycgan, 'to get in exchange for payment', and the exchange is still the whole sense.
senses.whyCN: buy 来自古英语 bycgan「用钱换得」，这种交换至今就是它的全部意思。

senses.title: To believe or accept, in informal talk
senses.definition: to believe or accept an idea or story, in informal speech
senses.definitionCN: 口语里表示相信或接受某种说法
senses.example: I don't buy that story.
senses.why: Informal English treats an idea as something offered for sale: if you accept it, you 'buy' it.
senses.whyCN: 口语把一种说法当成待售的货物：你接受了，就等于把它「买」了下来。

senses.title: A purchase, or something worth its price
senses.definition: a thing bought, or a purchase that was worth the money
senses.definitionCN: 买到的东西，或价钱划算的一次购买
senses.example: This bike was a good buy.
senses.why: The verb turned into a noun, so buy names either the purchase or the thing that proved worth buying.
senses.whyCN: 动词转作名词，buy 既可指一次购买，也可指买得划算的那件东西。

senses.why: Ear comes from Old English ēare, the Germanic name for the hearing organ, and the body part is its first sense.

senses.title: The ability to hear and judge sound
senses.definition: the ability to hear sounds well, especially music
senses.definitionCN: 分辨声音的能力，尤指对音乐的敏感
senses.example: She has a good ear for music.
senses.exampleCN: 她对音乐有很好的感受力。
senses.why: The organ that receives sound stands for the skill of judging it, so a good ear means good hearing or musical taste.
senses.whyCN: 接收声音的器官代指判断声音的能力，所以 a good ear 指听力好或乐感好。

senses.title: A seed-bearing head of grain
senses.definition: the part of a cereal plant that holds the grains
senses.definitionCN: 谷类植物结籽的穗状部分
senses.example: The farmer picked an ear of corn.
senses.why: This ear has a separate origin: Old English ēar meant a grain spike, and it only shares the spelling with the hearing organ.

senses.exampleCN: 他们一起喝完了整整一瓶。

senses.title: To put liquid into bottles
senses.definition: to fill bottles with a liquid, usually in a factory

senses.exampleCN: 这家工厂每天早上给牛奶装瓶。
senses.why: The noun turned into a verb, so bottle names the act of filling a bottle.
senses.whyCN: 名词转作动词，bottle 就表示往瓶子里装东西这个动作。

senses.title: To feed a baby or young animal with a bottle
senses.definition: to feed a baby or young animal from a bottle
senses.definitionCN: 用奶瓶给婴儿或幼崽喂奶
senses.example: She bottle-fed the lamb every two hours.
senses.exampleCN: 她每两小时用奶瓶喂一次小羊。
senses.why: When a baby is fed from a bottle instead of the breast, the verb bottle names that way of feeding.
senses.whyCN: 当婴儿不是吃母乳而是用奶瓶时，动词 bottle 就指这种喂养方式。

definition_en: at all times, every time, or forever
core_image: 钟摆一秒也不停，始终在同一个弧线上来回
scene: 院里的老钟走了很多年，指针从来没被调过。 The old clock always shows the right time.
sceneCN: 这里 always 是「总是」（第 01 个义项）；句意是那座老钟的时间总是准的。

derivatives.zh: 常开的，由 always 与 on 复合

senses.title: Every time, without exception
senses.definition: on every occasion, with no exception
senses.definitionCN: 每一次都如此，没有例外
senses.example: The old clock always shows the right time.
senses.exampleCN: 那座老钟的时间总是准的。
senses.why: Always comes from Old English ealne weg, 'the whole way', and a journey that lasts the whole way never stops, so the word means 'on every occasion'.
senses.whyCN: always 来自古英语 ealne weg「整条路」；走完整条路从未停下，所以这个词表示「每一次都」。

senses.title: For ever
senses.definition: for all future time, without end
senses.definitionCN: 在未来所有时间里，没有尽头
senses.example: I will always remember her kindness.
senses.exampleCN: 我会永远记得她的好意。
senses.why: Stretch that whole-way picture past the present into all coming time and the same word means 'for ever'.
senses.whyCN: 把「整条路」的画面从现在拉向所有未来的时间，同一个词就表示「永远」。

senses.title: Repeatedly, as a habit
senses.definition: again and again, often said with annoyance about a habit
senses.definitionCN: 一再发生，常带抱怨地指某种习惯
senses.example: He is always losing his keys.
senses.why: With a progressive verb the focus shifts from every single occasion to the endless repetition itself, which is why it sounds like a complaint.
senses.whyCN: 和进行时连用时，重点从「每一次」转到「没完没了地重复」，所以听起来像抱怨。

definition_en: a drawing or film made in a simple, amusing style
core_image: 屏幕上几个线条简单的小人正在追着一个圆球跑
scene: 屏幕上几个线条简单的小人正在追着一个圆球跑。 The children laugh at the cartoon.
sceneCN: 这里 cartoon 是「动画片」（第 01 个义项）；句意是孩子们看着动画片大笑。

senses.title: A humorous or satirical drawing
senses.definition: a drawing, often humorous or satirical, as in a newspaper
senses.definitionCN: 常带滑稽或讽刺意味的画，如报纸上的漫画
senses.example: He drew a cartoon of the teacher.
senses.exampleCN: 他画了一幅老师的漫画。
senses.why: Cartoon came from Italian cartone, 'thick paper', because painters first sketched a design on heavy paper; the word then named the drawing itself.
senses.whyCN: cartoon 来自意大利语 cartone「厚纸」，因为画家先在厚纸上画草图，这个词后来就指画本身。

senses.title: An animated film
senses.definition: a film made from a series of drawn images that appear to move
senses.definitionCN: 由一连串画面连成、看起来会动的影片
senses.example: The children laugh at the cartoon.
senses.exampleCN: 孩子们看着动画片大笑。
senses.why: When the drawings are put in sequence and moved, the result is an animated film, so cartoon also names the cartoon film.
senses.whyCN: 把一张张画排成序列动起来，结果就是动画影片，所以 cartoon 也指动画片。

senses.title: A comic strip in a newspaper
senses.definition: a series of small drawings telling a story in a newspaper
senses.definitionCN: 报纸上连续的小画，讲一个故事
senses.example: He reads the cartoons before the news.
senses.exampleCN: 他先看连环漫画，再看新闻。
senses.why: The same humorous drawings are printed in a row to tell a story, and that strip keeps the name cartoon.
senses.whyCN: 同样的滑稽画被排成一排讲故事，这一条画仍叫 cartoon。
